Container.Name: Glovebox
Container.Overview: Glovebox keeps track of your vehicles: MOT, road tax, insurance, servicing, breakdown cover, warranty and finance, all colour-coded by when they're due. Store policy numbers and claims lines, and pull up a one-tap emergency card at the roadside. Multi-user, with per-vehicle sharing. Data is stored in a single SQLite database in your appdata folder.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Glovebox web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database and uploaded documents. Back this up.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone, used for working out what's due today and when reminders are sent.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File permission mask for created files.
